about: Opening story shown when a new game starts. Hand-written from docs/Game story.docx as a placeholder; the story lead may rewrite it (or move it into the dialogue sheet as scene "Opening").

lines.text: The year is 2070. Artificial intelligence now does most of the work in the city, and your engineering job is gone.
With nothing keeping you there, you remember the farmhouse your family left behind in the countryside.
You arrive to find the house still standing, but the land around it overgrown and forgotten.

lines.speaker: {player}
lines.text: This place needs a lot of work... The village is just east of here. Maybe someone there can help me get started.
